senses.en: a reference work containing articles on many subjects, often arranged alphabetically

example.en: He looked up the name of the star in an encyclopaedia.
example.zh: 他在百科全书里查了那颗星的名字。

collocations: look something up in an encyclopaedia

senses.en: a contagious viral disease causing fever and swelling of the glands near the ears

example.en: He stayed home from school because he had mumps.
example.zh: 他因为得了流行性腮腺炎而没去上学。

senses.en: a black sticky substance from natural hydrocarbon mixtures, used for roads and waterproofing

example.en: Bitumen is widely used in road construction.
example.zh: 沥青被广泛用于道路建设。

senses.en: designed for or suitable to both men and women
senses.zh: 男女皆宜的；不分男女的

example.en: The store sells unisex clothing and unisex haircuts.
example.zh: 这家店售卖男女皆宜的服装，也提供男女通用的发型设计。

senses.en: a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold

example.en: We bought fresh bread at the bakery this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上我们在面包店买了新鲜面包。

senses.en: to answer someone in speech or writing

example.en: She responded to my email the next morning.
example.zh: 她第二天早上回复了我的电子邮件。

senses.en: to react to something with an action or feeling

example.en: The company responded quickly to the complaint.
example.zh: 公司对投诉迅速作出了回应。

senses.en: to improve or change as a result of medical treatment

example.en: The patient responded well to the treatment.
example.zh: 病人对治疗反应良好。

senses.en: to judge or measure the quality, importance, or size of something

example.en: Teachers assess students' progress at the end of each term.
example.zh: 教师在每学期末评估学生的进步。

senses.en: to calculate the amount of a tax, fine, or other payment

example.en: The court assessed a fine against the company.
example.zh: 法院对该公司判定了罚款。

senses.en: the industry concerned with aircraft and spacecraft; also the atmosphere and outer space considered together
senses.zh: 航空航天工业；航空航天领域

example.en: She works in the aerospace industry designing satellites.
example.zh: 她在航空航天行业从事卫星设计工作。

senses.en: a sedimentary rock made mostly of calcium carbonate, often formed from the remains of marine animals

example.en: The cliffs along the coast are made of white limestone.
example.zh: 海岸边的悬崖由白色石灰岩构成。

senses.en: a small standardized part attached to a larger system, such as pipes or wiring

example.en: The plumber bought some brass fittings for the pipes.
example.zh: 水管工买了一些黄铜管道配件。

senses.en: an occasion when you try on clothes being made or adjusted for you

example.en: She has a fitting for her wedding dress on Friday.
example.zh: 她周五要去试穿婚纱。

senses.en: appropriate or right for a particular occasion

example.en: It was a fitting end to a great career.
example.zh: 这对一个辉煌的职业生涯来说是一个合适的结局。

senses.en: fittings: the movable items such as furniture and equipment in a building or room

example.en: The office fittings were replaced during the renovation.
example.zh: 办公室的陈设设备在装修期间被更换了。

senses.en: a set of steps for going from one level to another inside a building

example.en: Take the stairway to the second floor.
example.zh: 走楼梯到二楼。

senses.en: to twist and squeeze something to remove liquid from it

example.en: She wrung out the wet towel before hanging it up.
example.zh: 她把湿毛巾拧干后才挂起来。

senses.en: to twist and rub one's hands together, often showing worry or distress

example.en: He wrung his hands while waiting for the results.
example.zh: 他等结果时焦虑地搓着双手。

senses.en: to obtain something from someone with effort or pressure

example.en: The company managed to wring a concession from its suppliers.
example.zh: 公司设法从供应商那里榨取了一项让步。

senses.en: full of joy; very happy

example.en: The children gave a joyful shout when they saw the snow.
example.zh: 孩子们看到下雪时发出欢乐的叫声。

senses.en: causing joy; delightful

example.en: Their wedding was a truly joyful celebration.
example.zh: 他们的婚礼是一场真正充满喜悦的庆典。

senses.en: to hold a formal ceremony to start someone's term in office
senses.zh: 举行就职典礼；使正式就任

example.en: The new president was inaugurated in January.
example.zh: 新总统于一月宣誓就职。

senses.en: to officially open or start a building, project, or event with a ceremony
senses.zh: 为……举行开幕式；正式启用

example.en: The city inaugurated its new airport last week.
example.zh: 该市上周举行了新机场的启用仪式。

senses.en: the act or position of placing something somewhere

example.en: The placement of the sofa makes the room look bigger.
example.zh: 沙发的摆放让房间显得更大。

senses.en: the act of arranging a job, internship or school class for someone
senses.zh: 工作安排；实习安置；编班

example.en: The college offers a work placement with local companies.
example.zh: 这所大学提供在当地公司的实习安排。

senses.en: the act of regularly observing and checking something

example.en: Continuous monitoring of air quality helps protect public health.
example.zh: 对空气质量的持续监测有助于保护公众健康。

senses.en: the town where you were born or grew up

example.en: He returned to his hometown after many years away.
example.zh: 他多年在外后回到了家乡。

senses.en: made to conform to a fixed standard

example.en: The school uses a standardized test for all new students.
example.zh: 这所学校对所有新生使用标准化测试。

senses.en: shared by or for use by a group of people

example.en: The apartment building has a communal garden for all residents.
example.zh: 这栋公寓楼有一个供所有住户使用的公共花园。

senses.en: the layer of grass and soil covering the ground

example.en: They laid new turf on the lawn.
example.zh: 他们在草坪上铺了新草皮。

senses.en: the area or territory that someone considers their own

example.en: He sees the neighborhood park as his turf.
example.zh: 他把社区公园当作自己的地盘。

senses.en: the emission of radiation from unstable atomic nuclei as they decay

example.en: Marie Curie discovered the elements polonium and radium while studying radioactivity.
example.zh: 玛丽·居里在研究放射性时发现了钋和镭元素。

senses.en: a thread-like substance found in food, plants, or materials that can be spun or made into fabric

example.en: Eating more fruit gives your body the fibre it needs.
example.zh: 多吃水果能为身体提供所需的纤维。

senses.en: one of the thread-like cells that make up muscles or nerves

example.en: Exercise strengthens the muscle fibres.
example.zh: 锻炼能增强肌肉纤维。

senses.en: a person's character or inner strength

example.en: She showed great moral fibre during the crisis.
example.zh: 她在危机中表现出坚强的道德意志。

senses.en: the 16th letter of the English alphabet
senses.zh: 英语字母表的第十六个字母

example.en: The word 'pen' starts with the letter p.
example.zh: 单词 pen 以字母 p 开头。

senses.en: abbreviation for page, used in books and documents

example.en: Please read the article on p. 12.
example.zh: 请阅读第12页上的文章。

senses.en: not any; not one (of a group or amount)

example.en: I checked all the shops, but none of them had the book.
example.zh: 我查了所有的商店，但没有一家有那本书。

senses.en: not at all; in no way (used to emphasize a following word)

example.en: She was none too pleased about the delay.
example.zh: 她对这次延误一点也不高兴。

senses.en: the ninth canonical hour of the church day, formerly read or chanted around 3 PM
senses.zh: （天主教）第九时辰祈祷（原在下午三时诵读）

example.en: In medieval monasteries, none was prayed in the afternoon.
example.zh: 在中世纪的修道院里，修士们在下午诵念第九时辰。

senses.en: the state of having no light; absence of light

example.en: The room was in complete darkness after the power cut.
example.zh: 停电后房间里一片漆黑。

senses.en: a dark area or place where there is little light

example.en: Something moved in the darkness beyond the doorway.
example.zh: 门口外的暗处有什么东西动了一下。

senses.en: evil, ignorance, or sadness, used figuratively
senses.zh: 黑暗；蒙昧；（喻）邪恶或悲伤

example.en: The film tells a story of hope rising out of darkness.
example.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个希望从黑暗中升起的故事。

senses.en: a person who worked to end slavery

example.en: Frederick Douglass was a famous abolitionist and writer.
example.zh: 弗雷德里克·道格拉斯是著名的废奴主义者和作家。

senses.en: clever and careful in dealing with others, especially in business

example.en: A canny investor bought shares before the price rose.
example.zh: 一位精明的投资者在股价上涨前买入了股票。

senses.en: to refuse to accept or acknowledge someone or something as yours

example.en: He disowned his son after a long quarrel.
example.zh: 经过长期争吵后，他声明与儿子断绝关系。

senses.en: evil or cruel, like a devil

example.en: The villain gave a devilish grin.
example.zh: 反派露出恶魔般的狞笑。

senses.en: playfully mischievous in an appealing way

example.en: She had a devilish sense of humor.
example.zh: 她有一种顽皮的幽默感。

senses.en: (informal) extremely; very

example.en: The exam was devilish difficult.
example.zh: 这次考试难得要命。

senses.en: at or near the back of an animal's body

example.en: The dog injured its hind leg.
example.zh: 那只狗的后腿受伤了。

senses.en: a female deer, especially a red deer

example.en: A hind watched the hunters from the trees.
example.zh: 一只雌鹿从树林中注视着猎人。

senses.en: unfair treatment or prejudice based on a person's sex

example.en: The company adopted policies to combat sexism in hiring.
example.zh: 该公司出台政策以打击招聘中的性别歧视。

senses.en: of a dull yellowish-brown color

example.en: He wore a khaki jacket on the hike.
example.zh: 他徒步时穿着一件卡其色夹克。

senses.en: a strong yellowish-brown cloth, or the color itself

example.en: The uniforms were made of khaki.
example.zh: 这些制服是用卡其布做的。

senses.en: not sensible or useful in real situations

example.en: Walking to work in this heat is completely impractical.
example.zh: 这么热的天走路去上班完全不现实。

senses.en: decorative clothing worn on the head

example.en: The dancer wore a colorful feather headdress.
example.zh: 那位舞者戴着一顶色彩鲜艳的羽毛头饰。

senses.en: only slightly warm

example.en: The soup was lukewarm by the time he sat down.
example.zh: 他坐下时汤已经温了。

senses.en: showing little interest or enthusiasm

example.en: The proposal received a lukewarm response.
example.zh: 该提案得到的反响冷淡。

senses.en: to separate or cause something to separate into pieces, often by force

example.en: The glass fell and broke on the floor.
example.zh: 玻璃杯掉在地上摔碎了。

senses.en: to stop working or fail to function

example.en: My phone broke during the trip.
example.zh: 我的手机在旅途中坏了。

senses.en: a short rest or pause from work or activity

example.en: Let's take a short break after lunch.
example.zh: 午饭后我们休息一会儿吧。

senses.en: a chance or opportunity, especially one that helps you succeed

example.en: She got her first break in the film industry.
example.zh: 她在电影行业得到了第一个机会。

senses.en: the business of making goods or providing services in a particular area

example.en: The tourism industry supports many local jobs.
example.zh: 旅游业为当地提供了许多就业机会。

senses.en: the making of goods in factories as a whole

example.en: New rules may affect industry across the country.
example.zh: 新规定可能会影响全国的工业。

senses.en: hard work and steady effort

example.en: Her industry helped her finish the project early.
example.zh: 她的勤奋帮助她提前完成了项目。

senses.en: the short, loud sound a dog makes

example.en: The dog's bark woke the baby.
example.zh: 狗的叫声吵醒了婴儿。

senses.en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog

example.en: The dog barked at the mail carrier.
example.zh: 狗对着邮递员叫。

senses.en: the outer covering of a tree

example.en: The tree's bark was rough and gray.
example.zh: 树皮粗糙且呈灰色。

senses.en: to say something in a sharp, loud voice

example.en: The coach barked orders at the players.
example.zh: 教练对球员大声下命令。

senses.en: a paper or electronic record that lets someone travel, enter a place, or attend an event
senses.zh: 票；入场券；车票（可为纸质或电子）

example.en: She bought two tickets for the evening train.
example.zh: 她买了两张晚班火车票。

senses.en: an official notice that you must pay a fine for a traffic or parking offence

example.en: He got a ticket for parking on the yellow line.
example.zh: 他因在黄线停车收到一张罚单。

senses.en: to give someone an official notice for a traffic or parking offence

example.en: The officer ticketed the car for blocking the entrance.
example.zh: 警察因那辆车堵住入口而给它开了罚单。

senses.en: a group of candidates that a political party offers in an election

example.en: The party chose a new ticket for the election.
example.zh: 该党为选举选出了新的候选人名单。

senses.en: letters exchanged between people

example.en: She kept all the correspondence from her old friend.
example.zh: 她保留了老朋友的所有来信。

senses.en: a close similarity or match between things

example.en: There is a clear correspondence between the two sets of results.
example.zh: 两组结果之间有明显的对应关系。

senses.en: unusually good; outstanding

example.en: She has exceptional talent for music.
example.zh: 她在音乐方面有非凡的才华。

senses.en: not typical; unusual or rare

example.en: The region saw exceptional rainfall last month.
example.zh: 该地区上个月降雨量异常。

senses.en: a tall vertical structure of stone, wood, or metal that supports a building

example.en: The roof is held up by four stone pillars.
example.zh: 屋顶由四根石柱支撑着。

senses.en: a person or thing considered a strong and important support of society or an organization
senses.zh: 台柱；栋梁；支柱（比喻重要支持者）

example.en: She is a pillar of the local community.
example.zh: 她是当地社区的支柱。

senses.en: an important principle or part on which something is based

example.en: Trust is a pillar of a healthy marriage.
example.zh: 信任是健康婚姻的基础。

senses.en: to push or drive something forward

example.en: The engine propels the ship through the water.
example.zh: 发动机推动轮船在水中前行。

senses.en: to cause someone to act or achieve something

example.en: Her ambition propelled her to the top of the company.
example.zh: 她的抱负驱使她登上了公司的高层。

senses.en: to force something or someone out of its usual place or position

example.en: The flood displaced thousands of families.
example.zh: 洪水使数千户家庭流离失所。

senses.en: to take the place of something, often by replacing it

example.en: Digital media is gradually displacing print newspapers.
example.zh: 数字媒体正在逐渐取代纸质报纸。

senses.en: morally bad or evil

example.en: The wicked stepmother treated Cinderella cruelly.
example.zh: 邪恶的继母虐待灰姑娘。

senses.en: playful or slightly naughty in a fun way

example.en: She gave him a wicked grin before telling the joke.
example.zh: 她讲笑话前朝他顽皮地咧嘴一笑。

senses.en: (informal, mainly British) excellent or impressive

example.en: That skateboard trick was absolutely wicked!
example.zh: 那个滑板动作真是太棒了！

senses.en: clearly and without doubt; definitely

example.en: The results were decidedly positive.
example.zh: 结果显然是积极的。

senses.en: in the same or similar way

example.en: She worked hard, and her brother did likewise.
example.zh: 她工作努力，她的弟弟也是如此。

senses.en: in addition; also

example.en: The rent must be paid, and likewise the electricity bill.
example.zh: 房租必须支付，电费也一样。

senses.en: a signal or prompt for someone to act or speak

example.en: The actor waited for his cue to go on stage.
example.zh: 那位演员等待上台的提示。

senses.en: a piece of information or evidence that helps you understand something

example.en: Her smile gave me a cue that she was happy with the plan.
example.zh: 她的微笑给了我一个线索，表明她对计划很满意。

senses.en: to give someone a signal to do or say something

example.en: The director cued the orchestra to begin.
example.zh: 导演提示乐队开始演奏。

senses.en: a long stick used to strike balls in billiards and snooker

example.en: He picked up his cue and studied the table.
example.zh: 他拿起球杆，观察球桌的局势。

senses.en: to look at something carefully to check its condition or quality

example.en: The engineer inspected the bridge for cracks.
example.zh: 工程师检查了这座桥有没有裂缝。

senses.en: to officially visit a place or work to see that rules are being followed

example.en: A government official inspected the factory last week.
example.zh: 一位政府官员上周视察了那家工厂。

senses.en: a gentle feeling of fondness, caring or love

example.en: She shows great affection for her grandmother.
example.zh: 她对祖母怀有深厚的感情。

senses.en: an unfair opinion or feeling formed without good reason

example.en: The report showed deep prejudice against older workers.
example.zh: 这份报告显示出对年长员工的深深偏见。

senses.en: to influence someone's opinion unfairly in advance

example.en: The media coverage may have prejudiced the jury.
example.zh: 媒体的报道可能使陪审团产生了偏见。

senses.en: an open container, especially one used for bathing or holding liquids

example.en: She filled the tub with warm water for a bath.
example.zh: 她在浴盆里放满了温水准备洗澡。

senses.en: a small round container with a lid, used for food or other products

example.en: He bought a tub of ice cream.
example.zh: 他买了一盒冰淇淋。

senses.en: to remove hair with a razor

example.en: He shaves every morning before work.
example.zh: 他每天早上上班前刮胡子。

senses.en: the act of removing hair with a razor

example.en: He gave himself a quick shave before dinner.
example.zh: 他在晚饭前快速刮了个脸。

senses.en: a lake or large tank used to store water

example.en: The dam created a huge reservoir behind it.
example.zh: 大坝在其后形成了一个巨大的水库。

senses.en: a large supply or store of something

example.en: She has a deep reservoir of patience.
example.zh: 她有着深厚的耐心储备。

senses.en: to fall suddenly and sharply

example.en: House prices plummeted last year.
example.zh: 去年房价暴跌。

senses.en: grand and impressive in appearance

example.en: The imposing building stands at the center of the old city.
example.zh: 那座气势恢宏的建筑矗立在老城中心。

senses.en: done without conscious control or intention

example.en: Shivering is an involuntary reaction to cold.
example.zh: 颤抖是对寒冷的无意识反应。

senses.en: happening unwillingly or by chance

example.en: He made an involuntary confession under pressure.
example.zh: 他在压力下作了非自愿的供述。

senses.en: to make something a standard, established practice

example.en: Regular safety checks were institutionalized after the accident.
example.zh: 事故之后，定期安全检查被制度化。

senses.en: to place someone in an institution for long-term care
senses.zh: 把（某人）送进收容机构（如医院、养老院）

example.en: His grandmother was institutionalized when her health declined.
example.zh: 他的祖母健康状况恶化后被送进了护理机构。

senses.en: kind, generous, and wishing others well

example.en: A benevolent donor paid for the new library.
example.zh: 一位仁慈的捐赠者出资修建了新图书馆。

senses.en: a waterproof raincoat

example.en: He put on his mackintosh before walking out in the rain.
example.zh: 他在冒雨出门前穿上了雨衣。

senses.en: the ability to produce many offspring; fertility

example.en: The river's fecundity supports many fish species.
example.zh: 这条河的丰饶养育着许多鱼类。

senses.en: richness of creative or intellectual output

example.en: Critics admired the fecundity of the novelist's imagination.
example.zh: 评论家钦佩这位小说家想象力的丰富。

senses.en: one of the two lower chambers of the heart that pumps blood out

example.en: The left ventricle pumps blood to the whole body.
example.zh: 左心室将血液泵送到全身。

senses.en: one of the small fluid-filled cavities in the brain

example.en: The ventricles of the brain contain cerebrospinal fluid.
example.zh: 大脑的脑室含有脑脊液。

senses.en: formed from sediment that has settled, or relating to such material
senses.zh: 沉积的；由沉淀物形成的

example.en: Limestone is a common sedimentary rock.
example.zh: 石灰岩是一种常见的沉积岩。

senses.en: a game in which players hit a small ball with their hands against a wall or into a goal

example.en: He plays handball twice a week.
example.zh: 他每周打两次手球。

senses.en: a pointed stick used to drive cattle; a thing that urges someone to act
senses.zh: 赶牛棒；（喻）刺激物，驱使因素

example.en: Hunger was a constant goad to keep working.
example.zh: 饥饿是驱使他不断劳作的因素。

senses.en: to repeatedly urge or provoke someone until they react

example.en: He goaded his brother into losing his temper.
example.zh: 他不断刺激他弟弟，使他发了脾气。

senses.en: jobs that require special education and training, such as medicine or law
senses.zh: 专业；职业（如医生、律师等）

example.en: Teaching and nursing are two of the most respected professions.
example.zh: 教师和护士是最受尊敬的两个职业。

senses.en: an open declaration of a belief, feeling, or faith
senses.zh: 声明；表白；（宗教信仰的）公开表白

example.en: His constant professions of loyalty seemed insincere.
example.zh: 他不断表白忠诚，显得并不真诚。
